findings.finding: There are 40 DEX and 51,578 distinct defined class descriptors, with no duplicate defined descriptors. Every manifest component has a DEX definition. Historical source folders are not evidence of simultaneous runtime instances.
findings.action: Keep owner and JNI definitions; remove a class only after its Java/native/manifest/reflection callers are replaced or proved unreachable.

findings.finding: The Application remains YuzuApplication in the main process. Its onCreate executes guards for each system and returns early when a guard selects an emulator process. The main branch subsequently invokes PlatformAssets.install, BootstrapAssets.installKeys, Freedreno config, driver/input initialization and NativeLibrary device information. The guards do not initialize every emulator. PSX is intercepted by classes28's factory, and Sony has minimal private Applications.
findings.action: Measure main-process cold-start work separately. A later lazy Switch bootstrap must preserve original Application globals, driver/input readiness and Switch launch, including provider-first startup. This audit makes no temperature or CPU percentage claim.

findings.finding: StationSonyOfflineActivity is declared and referenced by the native carousel, but StationSonyComponentFactory substitutes StationSonyLaunchActivity when Android instantiates that name. The old external implementation therefore is not the ordinary R131 Sony launch path. Its presence is not evidence that an external emulator runs alongside the internal owner.
findings.action: If consolidating, replace the existing implementation under its compatible component name or patch every native caller and manifest together. Do not simply delete the declaration/class name.

findings.finding: StationNetplayActivity is referenced in the native carousel. Its bytecode still constructs StationDolphinNetplayActivity. These are separate from StationRoomsActivity's current native-owner dispatch. Neither route is proved globally unreachable merely because the Rooms path does not use it.
findings.action: Retain pending exact native callsite and menu-option migration. A class-name literal is a possible reference, not proof that it is executing.

findings.finding: StationRoomsActivity stops artwork, polling, graphic listeners and pending UI requests onStop, then closes artwork and executor queues onDestroy. DownloadService stops itself when ACTIVE becomes empty and returns START_NOT_STICKY. StationSessionService is bound and releases anchors on unbind/destroy. No BOOT_COMPLETED receiver exists; the only receiver is the DUMP-protected profile installer.
findings.action: Keep download resume, room membership and Binder ownership. Investigate a leak only with an unfinished task/anchor or resumed-state contradiction, rather than removing all services.

findings.finding: The package declares 20 providers, including 10 namespaced startup providers. Initializers include lifecycle, emoji/profile installation and the Wii U OkHttp platform initializer. They are process roots when the corresponding process is created, not 20 continuously running workers.
findings.action: Changing initializers needs an owner-by-owner dependency review. File/DocumentProviders and namespace SDK copies support distinct emulator imports and settings.

findings.finding: StationPsxLaunch creates files/station-psx-online/<launch>/home for every launch and writes presentation resources/settings there. Its consume/discard delete only the launch descriptor. Human-exit cleanup closes transport/Binder/native owner but does not remove the home. This proves no per-home retention cleanup in the audited launch/exit paths, not that the directory contains disposable data.
findings.action: Separate presentation cache from saves. Only remove an exact app-owned completed launch after owner/descriptor/transport completion and preserve/migrate saves. Do not sweep active, pending or unknown homes.

findings.finding: Retro online directories retain per-room saves/states and shared BIOS/autoconfig/overlays. Overlay preparation reads and compares packaged data before skipping identical writes. PS3 userdata includes firmware and saves. PS4 module/runtime and shader/cache paths are validated and reused; session IPC is closed at native-run return. These private directories are functional, not inherently obsolete sandboxes.
findings.action: Optimize verified shared preparation/cache only with identity- and lifecycle-aware reuse. Keep firmware, games, saves, shader cache, current native assets and pending transfer transactions.

findings.finding: No Java DEX literal sandbox, no packaged template/path roms/sandbox, no packedprobe/testroots marker and no path-like sandbox value were found in standard libraries, DEX or non-Sony packaged text assets. Native sandbox matches are QEMU options, SDL APIs, Yuzu filesystem symbols and game metadata. Remote catalog and deleted-device directory evidence were not read in this subtask.
findings.action: Capture the exact recreated path and creation window, then trace the native-supplied ROM root and runtime catalog/publication. Do not attribute it to a library just because it contains the word sandbox.

findings.finding: StationInstaller confines game generations under roms/.station-v2/<verified platform>/<item>/<install generation>/content and deletes only uncommitted failed generations. StationPublication skips unsupported platforms, StationPlatforms.resolve uses a fixed mapping, and StationFrontend prepares the application-supplied root; these paths do not derive a new root folder from a remote hostname.
findings.action: Preserve .station-v2, private install receipts and download staging. Orphan-generation cleanup needs a complete receipt/queue reachability set and must exclude active transactions and last committed generation.
